title: source index coverage gate
decision: 默认 knowledge-check 要求 by-source 主表覆盖所有 registry source id。
evidence: tools/knowledge-check.sh by_source_ids coverage check; /tmp missing-source fixture reports index:indexes/by-source.md missing source codex-memories
risk: 只检查 source id 覆盖，不自动验证说明段落。

title: source index stale gate
decision: 默认 knowledge-check 要求 by-source 主表不得包含未登记 source id。
evidence: tools/knowledge-check.sh by_source_ids stale check; /tmp stale-source fixture reports index:indexes/by-source.md stale source ghost-source; /tmp extra-review-table fixture still passes
risk: 只解析 # Knowledge Sources 下第一个主表第一列，避免误判 review artifact 段落或后续说明表格。

title: source id uniqueness
decision: 默认 knowledge-check 检查 source id 重复。
evidence: tools/knowledge-check.sh source_ids duplicate check; rtk bash tools/knowledge-check.sh --sources-only --dry-run --json pass
risk: 只检查 id 唯一，不改变已有 source 状态或外部路径。
